INTJ: - Pay more attention to the feelings and needs of others.
- Sometimes let things go, let go of control a little.
- Practice explaining ideas to others in a simpler way.
- Take eye contact and body language seriously.
- Practice patience for long-term results while enjoying the moment.
INTP: - Don't just analyze things in your head, do them.
- Think simply instead of complicating things.
- Talk about your feelings with others.
- Practice living in the moment, not just in ideas.
ENTJ: - Manage with more compassion, not just logic.
- Learn to listen actively, not just talk.
- Don't try to win in arguments, try to understand.
- Empathize with people who are more calm and emotional.
- Stop and take care of yourself sometimes.
ENTP: - Take finishing things as seriously as starting them.
- Be more sensitive to the feelings of others.
- Hyperactivity causes mental instability, practice concentration.
INFJ: - Don't expect too much from yourself, perfectionism is toxic.
- Talk about your own needs, not just others'.
- Overcome the guilt of saying no.
- Don't constantly expend your energy, recharging is essential.
INFP: - Don't strive for absolute perfection, be realistic.
- Practice facing up to tension instead of retreating.
- Write down or express your feelings, not just keep them to yourself.
- Daily structure can help you stay focused.
- Practice making decisions, even if it doesn't always feel right.
ENFJ: - Sometimes put yourself first, not just others.
- Draw a line between helping and exhausting yourself.
- Don't run away from vulnerability, there's power in being real.
- You're not always responsible for other people's feelings.
- Take time to grow yourself, not just lead others.
ENFP: - There is a lot of unfinished work, finish it.
- You get energy from the attention of others, but you also need solitude.
- Learn to say no, it is also part of self-knowledge.
ISTJ: - Practice flexibility, the plan doesn't always work.
- Don't be afraid of new experiences sometimes.
- Just because it's legal doesn't mean it's right.
ISFJ: - Set your personal boundaries, sacrifice is not good.
- Worrying about everyone is harmful to yourself.
- Practice disagreement, it is necessary for growth.
- Focus on your own goals too.
- Don't be afraid of solitude, it is an opportunity for recovery and reflection.
ESTJ: - Being too strict can be exhausting.
- You can't control everything, practice acceptance.
- Be more attentive to the feelings of those around you.
ESFJ: - You don't need to be popular all the time.
- Stop depending on the approval of others.
- Set aside time for yourself, not just for service.
ISTP: - Don't suppress your feelings, analyze them.
- Planning is also necessary, not just making decisions in the moment.
- Don't look at relationships as projects.
- Give others the opportunity to feel safe around you.
- Sometimes stillness is growth, not just movement.
ISFP: - The need for peace is not a reason to avoid change.
- Your feelings are valuable, even if others don't understand them.
ESTP: - Sometimes stop and think before you act.
- Don't sacrifice depth of connection for excitement.
- Think long term, not just momentary.
- Don't be indifferent to other people's feelings.
- You have value even when you're quiet.
ESFP: - Accept solitude as part of the balance.
- You don't grow with just fun, structure is important too.
- Don't say everything you need to.
- Practice moving forward with a plan.
- Experience discomfort instead of running away from it.
